Audited baseline commit 52cb5457f6c4 source bindings (including repair_service.py blob 6e0e3e50 and SHA-256 3cb51a89, and catalog SHA-256 b95ce7c1) and standalone extracted-archive skip/pass partition.
Audited all 61 baseline antibody records, confirming static negative_fixture, positive_fixture, and target_pattern string fields across 49 placeholder rows and 12 short snippet rows.
Audited stdlib-only imports, module-local toy classes (DangerSignal, ThymicCheckResult, CemeteryDAGSink), and the three toy unit tests.
Audited baseline catalog SHA-256 check, 49/61 placeholder fixture census, and non-executing data-file inspection.

Audited Rust pharmacy_search rule_digest, candidate selection, and attach_candidate_hits, confirming fixtures are hashed in RULE_KEYS, omitted from selected rule objects, and unused during target_pattern hit attachment.
